message:
Bind filesystem read admission and consumption to one descriptor

Apply the exact two-file filesystem156 Source successor over frozen #802.
Preserve text and media thresholds, explicit text opt-outs, projection and
physical-root prechecks. Consume at most admitted bytes plus one sentinel,
reject detectable size/identity changes, and close the read-only descriptor.

Use ES2017-compatible BigInt constructors in the reader and focused tests.
Source proposal only; no runtime, test or native acceptance is inherited.
